import unittest

from solution import choose_groups


class ChooseGroupsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_standard_lexicographic_index_order(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            choose_groups(["a", "b", "c", "d"], 2),
            [
                ["a", "b"],
                ["a", "c"],
                ["a", "d"],
                ["b", "c"],
                ["b", "d"],
                ["c", "d"],
            ],
        )

    def test_identity_preserved_even_for_equal_items(self):
        first = {"value": 1}
        second = {"value": 1}
        third = []
        result = choose_groups((first, second, third), 2)
        self.assertIs(result[0][0], first)
        self.assertIs(result[0][1], second)
        self.assertIs(result[1][0], first)
        self.assertIs(result[1][1], third)
        self.assertIs(result[2][0], second)
        self.assertIs(result[2][1], third)

    def test_zero_full_and_excess_sizes(self):
        self.assertEqual(choose_groups([], 0), [[]])
        self.assertEqual(choose_groups([1, 2], 0), [[]])
        self.assertEqual(choose_groups([1, 2], 3), [])
        self.assertEqual(choose_groups([1, 2], 2), [[1, 2]])

    def test_fresh_containers_and_no_input_mutation(self):
        items = [object(), object(), object()]
        original = items[:]
        first = choose_groups(items, 1)
        second = choose_groups(items, 1)
        self.assertEqual(items, original)
        self.assertIsNot(first, second)
        self.assertIsNot(first[0], second[0])
        first[0].append("new element")
        self.assertEqual(len(second[0]), 1)
        zero_first = choose_groups(items, 0)
        zero_second = choose_groups(items, 0)
        self.assertIsNot(zero_first, zero_second)
        self.assertIsNot(zero_first[0], zero_second[0])

    def test_malformed_arguments(self):
        bad_calls = [
            (None, 1),
            ({1, 2}, 1),
            ("abc", 1),
            ([1], True),
            ([1], -1),
            ([1], 1.0),
            ([1], None),
        ]
        for args in bad_calls:
            with self.subTest(args=args):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    choose_groups(*args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
